cls: Plasma-derived coagulation factor (I); fibrin sealant component
pharm: Plasma-derived coagulation factor (I); fibrin sealant component
quick: Dose (mg/kg) = (target fibrinogen mg/dL minus measured mg/dL) / 1.7; 70 mg/kg if the level is unknown
summary: Human fibrinogen concentrate replaces fibrinogen in congenital or acquired deficiency. Fibrinogen is also one half of fibrin sealant kits (with thrombin) applied topically during surgery.
indications: Acute bleeding in congenital afibrinogenaemia or hypofibrinogenaemia
Acquired hypofibrinogenaemia in major bleeding (specialist/protocol use)
Topical haemostasis as fibrin sealant (with thrombin)

dosage.d: Dose (mg/kg) = (target fibrinogen mg/dL minus measured mg/dL) / 1.7; 70 mg/kg if the level is unknown
dosage.n: Target usually 100 mg/dL for minor and 150 mg/dL for major bleeding

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Converted by thrombin to fibrin, forming the clot matrix.

relative: Thrombosis risk: history of thrombosis, DIC

serious: Air or gas embolism with spray application of sealant

counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
